notes.HLE-Verified: A verified and revised version of Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), accompanied by a transparent, component-wise verification protocol and a fine-grained error taxonomy. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/skylenage/HLE-Verified
notes.TAU2-Bench: Follows official setup except for the airline domain, where all models are evaluated by applying the fixes proposed in the Claude Opus 4.5 system card.
notes.MCP-Mark: GitHub MCP server uses v0.30.3 from api.githubcopilot.com; Playwright tool responses are truncated at 32k tokens.
notes.Search Agent: Most Search Agents built on Qwen model adopt a simple context-folding strategy (256k): once the cumulative Tool Response length reaches a preset threshold, earlier Tool Responses are pruned from the history to keep the context within limits.
notes.BrowseComp: Two strategies tested: simple context-folding achieved 69.0, while using the same discard-all strategy as DeepSeek-V3.2 and Kimi K2.5 achieved 78.6.
notes.WideSearch: Uses a 256k context window without any context management.
notes.WMT24++: A harder subset of WMT24 after difficulty labeling and rebalancing; averaged scores on 55 languages using XCOMET-XXL.
notes.MAXIFE: Accuracy on English + multilingual original prompts (totally 23 settings).
notes.null_values: null indicates scores not yet available or not applicable (shown as '--' in original).
